citation.description: strategy.matrix.include lists three arms: anthropic, bedrock, openai

criteria.criterion: The external suite runs its live jobs for MORE THAN ONE provider, with provider as an explicit matrix dimension rather than an ambient default.

citation.description: All three providers in matrix table; OpenAI coverage rationale documented

criteria.criterion: Anthropic and Bedrock are both covered. OpenAI is covered where a credential exists, or its absence is recorded as a deliberate decision with the reason.

citation.description: test_each_overlay_sets_only_the_model_selection_keys pins both [llm] model + model_classes (ticket documents why both are required); test_an_overlay_repoints_every_class_and_preserves_the_discovered_config exercises real config layering. REBAR_LLM_MODEL is never set (test_the_deprecated_bare_model_variable_is_never_set). Overlays set model+model_classes only — the criterion's 'ONLY model_classes' was superseded by the f124 incident fix documented in the ticket comments.

criteria.criterion: Each arm selects its provider via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing at a config file that sets ONLY [llm.model_classes], NOT via the deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL. A test or CI assertion pins that the override changes provider/model and leaves the rest of the discovered config intact.

citation.description: Credential preflight step emits ::error:: and exits non-zero for each provider arm; llm-live-canary in conftest.py provides second line of defence

criteria.criterion: An arm whose credential is ABSENT skips LOUDLY and is distinguishable in the run output from an arm that ran and passed — a missing secret must never read as green.

citation.description: id-token: write at job level; configure-aws-credentials step gated on matrix.provider == 'bedrock'; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY guarded on matrix.provider == 'anthropic'. Tests test_the_bedrock_arm_assumes_a_role_over_oidc and test_the_bedrock_arm_receives_no_llm_api_key in test_ci_provider_matrix.py pin these properties.

criteria.criterion: The Bedrock arm obtains credentials by a NAMED mechanism valid on a GitHub-hosted runner — OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials to a dedicated scoped role — and a test or CI assertion pins that it does not silently fall back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

citation.description: Both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION set from AWS_BEDROCK_CI_REGION variable; test_the_bedrock_arm_sets_both_region_variables in test_ci_provider_matrix.py pins this; test_bedrock_arm_resolved_a_region in test_provider_matrix_live.py asserts region at runtime

criteria.criterion: The Bedrock arm resolves an AWS region explicitly, setting BOTH AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION as job env, and FAILS LOUDLY with the typed configuration error when no region resolves.

citation.description: Cost table with measured token counts and dollar amounts from three real CI runs; cadence decision 'every credentialed provider runs on every trigger' with full rationale including tradeoff analysis

criteria.criterion: The per-trigger COST of the matrix is measured and recorded, and the cadence decision (every trigger vs reduced cadence/subset per provider) is stated with its rationale.
